summary: This policy governs the approval and payment of supplier invoices, version 3.1, in force from 1 January 2026.
Where a clause conflicts with a signed contract, the signed contract prevails and the case goes to Finance.
Policy applies to all invoices for goods or services delivered to Northwind BV and its subsidiaries
Policy does not apply to employee expense claims
Policy does not apply to intercompany recharges
Purchases above EUR 500 excluding VAT must have a purchase order raised before ordering goods or services
Invoices above EUR 500 without a purchase order number cannot be approved for payment and must be referred to the cost centre owner for retrospective authorisation
Purchases at or below EUR 500 excluding VAT do not require a purchase order
Up to EUR 1,000 invoices may be approved by the cost centre owner.
Above EUR 1,000 up to EUR 10,000 invoices must be approved by a department head.
Above EUR 10,000 up to EUR 50,000 invoices must be approved by the Finance Director.
Above EUR 50,000 invoices must be approved by two board members and the approval must be minuted.
No individual may approve an invoice they themselves submitted or that names them as the requester.
Invoices from approved suppliers (Contoso Cleaning Services BV, Fabrikam Office Supplies BV, Northwind IT Partners BV, Tailspin Facilities BV, Woodgrove Legal BV) may be processed normally.
Invoices from suppliers not on the approved list must be routed to Procurement for a supplier check before payment.
Standard payment term is 30 days from invoice date
Refer supplier to Finance if payment demanded in fewer than 14 days
Early settlement discounts may be taken if contract provides for them
Only Dutch statutory VAT rates of 0%, 9%, and 21% are acceptable on domestic invoices
Invoice totals must add up correctly; invoices with arithmetic errors must be returned to the supplier
Reject any invoice with a supplier and invoice number combination already recorded against a paid invoice
When a supplier reissues a corrected invoice, credit the original invoice before processing the corrected one
Invoices must be payable in euro; non-euro invoices require Finance conversion at the rate on the invoice date with documentation of the rate used.
Route non-euro invoices to Finance for currency conversion and rate recording.
Route invoice to Finance when policy does not settle a case or two clauses conflict
Unsure approvers must escalate rather than approve
Escalation is not treated as a fault or error
